Smt. Bhawna Purohit vs Bobby Singh on 7 May, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:21249
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh
 On The 7 th Of May, 2
 Misc. Appeal No. 461 of 2
 Smt. Bhawna Purohit And Others
 Versus
Bobby Singh And Others

Appearance:
 Shri Shashank Pandey - Advocate for the appellants.

Shri Mohd. Siddeeque - Advocate for respondent No.2
 Heard on:- 12.01.2024.

at Jaba
 Posted on:- 07.05.2025.

This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred
feeling aggrieved by the award dated 19.06.2014 in Claim Case no. No.30/2012 by Motor Accident
Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur for enhancement of Rs.20,00,000/- compensation.
2.  Facts in brief are that Ashok Purohit was posted as Accountant Officer in South Eastern Coal Field Ltd. District Umariya.

entities.text: South Eastern Coal Field Ltd. District Umariya
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He was aged 55 years and his annual income was Rs.6,29,267/- per annum.
On 06.05.2012 at about 5:00-5:30 am, Ashok Purohit was on an official tour of Jabalpur by Scorpio vehicle no.MP-18-T-1586.
The vehicle was driven by Ramnaresh.
Ramnaresh was driving the vehicle negligently even on the warning of Ashok Purohit.

Driver Ramnaresh did not drive the vehicle and overturned at NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21249 2 MA-461-2015 village Barodi,
Tehsil Shahpura distrid Dindori.
Ashok Purohit and thereafter Ramnaresh sustained injuries they were shifted to Jabalpur Hospital where Ashok Purohit succumbed to injuries.

A claim under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 was preferred against the Insurance Company and the owner of the vehicle Bobby Singh impleading the son Rishabh Purohit non- applicant no.3, daughter Radhika Tiwari as non-applicant no.4, wife of A.K. Purohit and son Rishikesh Purohit for compensation of Rs.80,00,000/-.
3.
Respondent no.1/owner of the vehicle contested the case on the ground that he is not liable for any compensation.
Ultimately, he prayed that respondent no.2 be directed to satisfy the award.
4. Respondent no.2/Insurance Company also contested the case on the ground that driver was not having a valid and effective driving license for driving the vehicle.

The vehicle was used as a Tax Smt. Bhawna Purohit vs Bobby Singh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113710694/
1 whereas it is insured as a private vehicle.

sentences.text: Claim is excessively exaggerated.
Income of the Ashok Purohit was denied.
5. Non-applicants no.3 and 4 supported the claim of the claimants.

6. Tribunal framed the issues and recorded the evidence of Bhawna Purohit (PW-1), Swapan Shrivastava (PW-2), Manager Personnel at South Eastern Coal Field Ltd, R.S. Rao (PW-3) and admitted the documents Ex.P-1 to P-15.

No evidence was adduced on behalf of non-applicants.
7.
Tribunal found proved that Ashok Purohit died due to negligent driving of Scorpio vehicle no.MP-18-T-1586 owned by respondent no.1 and insured by respondent no.2.

On the basis of salary slip (Ex.A-13) of March, 2012 assessed the monthly income of Ashok Purohit as Rs.83,394/- and after NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21249 3 MA-461-2015 deducting 1/3 for personal expenses calculated the loss of yearly dependency to the tune of Rs.4,19,511/-, it also estimated the age of Ashok Purohit as 55 years applying the multiplier of 11 calculated loss of dependency to the tune of Rs.46,14,621/-, awarded an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- in the head of loss of consortium and an amount of Rs.25,000/- in the head of funeral expenses and awarded a total compensation of Rs.47,39,621/- with interest of Rs.7.5% per annum from the date of application i.e. 02.07.2012.

8. Feeling dissatisfied with the award, this appeal has been preferred on the ground that deduction of Rs.17,377/- from the monthly salary is against the law and appellants are also entitled for enhancement in the head of future prospect.

9. Heard.
10.
Respondent no.2 opposed the appeal.

11. Perused the record.
12.
In this appeal, the vital issue arises whether amount of Rs.17,377/- mentioned in Ex.A-13 forms part of the income of the deceased Ashok Purohit.
Second vital issue arises whether Trial Court committed error in not taking into consideration the enhancement for future prospect.

13. The addition towards future prospect has to be considered in the light of para 61 of the National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi, (2017) 16 SCC 680 which is reproduced as below:-
"61.

entities.text: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi, (2017) 16 SCC 680
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the aforesaid analysis, we proceed to record our conclusions:-
(i) The two-Judge Bench in Santosh Devi should have been well advised to refer the matter to a larger Bench NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21249 4 MA-461-2015 as it was taking a different view than what has been stated in Sarla Verma, a judgment by a coordinate Bench.
It is because a coordinate Bench of the same strength cannot take a contrary view than what has been held by another coordinate Bench.

Smt. Bhawna Purohit vs Bobby Singh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113710694/
2
(ii) As Rajesh has not taken note of the decision in Reshma Kumari, which was delivered at earlier point of time, the decision in Rajesh is not a binding precedent.

(iii) While determining the income, an addition of 50% of actual salary to the income of the deceased towards future prospects, where the deceased had a permanent job and was below the age of 40 years, should be made.
The addition should be 30%, if the age of the deceased was between 40 to 50 years.
In case the deceased was between the age of 50 to 60 years, the addition should be 15%.
Actual salary should be read as actual salary less tax.
(iv) In case the deceased was self-employed or on a fixed salary, an addition of 40% of the established income should be the warrant where the deceased was below the age of 40 years.
An addition of 25% where the deceased was between the age of 40 to 50 years and 10% where the deceased was between the age of 50 to 60 years should be regarded as the necessary method of computation.
The established income means the income minus the tax component."
14. Tribunal has recorded the finding that deceased was aged about 55 years and he has a permanent job in South Eastern Coal Field Ltd. as Deputy Manager, Finance.
Accordingly, his job was permanent and 15% of addition to actual salary was required towards future prospect.
No such addition has been made.
Accordingly, 15% addition is allowed to the actual salary of Ashok Purohit.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21249 5 MA-461-2015 15.
Now the question arises whether amount of Rs.17,377/- had to be added towards the salary.

The Tribunal has discussed in para-13 of the award regarding Ex.A-13 in which gross salary is to be stated as Rs.83,394/- and the amount of Rs.17,377.62/- has been mentioned as perks and Tribunal has not taken into consideration the amount of perks in the actual income.
Perks are called perquisites.
They does not found the part of actual salary.
So Tribunal did not commit error in not taking into the amount of Rs.17,377/- in actual salary of the Ashok Purohit.
All addition of 15% of annual dependency comes to Rs.4,82,478/- in stead of Rs.4,19,511/- and applying the multiplier of 11 total loss of dependency comes to Rs.53,06,818/-
Tribunal has assessed a total amount of loss of dependency to the tune of Rs.46,14,621/-.
Accordingly, an amount of Rs.6,92,197/- is required to be enhanced in the head of loss of dependency.
Amount of Rs.5,000/- is required to be enhanced in the head of funeral expenses and loss of estate.
The mother of Ashok Purohit has expired during the pendency of appeal.
Accordingly, interference is not required in the amount of consortium.
16. Accordingly, this appeal is allowed and a total compensation of Rs.6,97,197/- is further enhanced in the head of loss of dependency, funeral expenses and loss of estate.
The enhanced amount shall be paid with interest @7.5% from the date of application i.e. 02.07.2012.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE HK NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21249 6 MA-461-2015 Smt. Bhawna Purohit vs Bobby Singh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113710694/
